tokens.name: bg-0
tokens.usage: Map canvas ground. QGraphicsView background brush.

tokens.name: bg-1
tokens.usage: Main window, toolbar, overlay solid fallback.

tokens.name: bg-2
tokens.usage: Side panels, dialogs, node body.

tokens.name: bg-3
tokens.usage: Inputs, table header, raised rows, combo popups.

tokens.name: bg-4
tokens.usage: Hover fill for rows, buttons and nodes.

tokens.name: line-1
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between panels, table rows, node inner rules.

tokens.name: line-2
tokens.usage: Control borders (buttons, inputs, node outline). 3.2:1 on bg-3.

tokens.name: grid-dot
tokens.usage: Map canvas dot grid, one dot every 24px at 100% zoom.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg-0 … bg-4 (≥ 12:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, column headers, J-names under custom names, on bg-0 … bg-4 (≥ 7:1).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: ages, units, hints. 4.6:1 on bg-4, 5.6:1 on bg-1. Never below 11px.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled control text and icons only (contrast exempt). Always paired with a disabled cursor/state.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on every bright fill: class badges, owner tags, accent buttons, character markers.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Selection, focus ring, primary button fill, active tab, links. 10:1 on bg-1; on-accent text is ink-inverse.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover, focused input border.

tokens.name: accent-dim
tokens.usage: Selected row fill (16% accent) behind ink text.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Valid / installed / connected. Always with ✓ glyph. Teal, off the red–green axis.

tokens.name: success-dim
tokens.usage: Success banner fill behind ink.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warnings, reduced mass, stale-but-usable data. Always with ▲ glyph or label.

tokens.name: warning-dim
tokens.usage: Warning banner fill; 'missing from last paste' row fill.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, destructive buttons, critical mass. Always with ✕ / ! glyph or label.

tokens.name: danger-dim
tokens.usage: Danger banner / invalid input fill.

tokens.name: stale
tokens.usage: Stale data marker: drawn as 45° hatch (4px pitch) plus 'stale 14m' label; never colour alone.

tokens.name: class-c1
tokens.usage: C1 class badge fill (filled = w-space). Text ink-inverse.

tokens.name: class-c2
tokens.usage: C2 class badge fill. Text ink-inverse (5.7:1).

tokens.name: class-c3
tokens.usage: C3 class badge fill.

tokens.name: class-c4
tokens.usage: C4 class badge fill.

tokens.name: class-c5
tokens.usage: C5 class badge fill.

tokens.name: class-c6
tokens.usage: C6 class badge fill. Text ink-inverse (5.1:1).

tokens.name: class-thera
tokens.usage: Thera badge fill, label 'TH'.

tokens.name: class-c13
tokens.usage: C13 shattered badge: fill plus diagonal crack notch, label 'C13'.

tokens.name: class-drifter
tokens.usage: Drifter w-space badge, label 'DR'.

tokens.name: class-pochven
tokens.usage: Pochven badge, label 'PV'; drawn with a triangle corner cut.

tokens.name: class-hs
tokens.usage: High-sec: OUTLINED badge (k-space is never filled), label 'HS' + security 0.5–1.0.

tokens.name: class-ls
tokens.usage: Low-sec: outlined badge, label 'LS' + security.

tokens.name: class-ns
tokens.usage: Null-sec: outlined badge, label 'NS' + security.

tokens.name: empire-amarr

tokens.name: empire-amarr-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of an amarr node body.

tokens.name: empire-gallente

tokens.name: empire-gallente-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of an gallente node body.

tokens.name: empire-minmatar
tokens.usage: Node body of a high-/low-sec system in Minmatar space (dark tint of bg-1; ink ≥ 12:1).

tokens.name: empire-minmatar-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of an minmatar node body.

tokens.usage: No effect: dashed empty circle, or omit the icon.

tokens.name: edge-fresh
tokens.usage: Connection, fresh mass: solid line, 2px.

tokens.name: edge-reduced
tokens.usage: Connection, reduced (<50%): solid 2.5px + 'R' chip on the label.

tokens.name: edge-critical
tokens.usage: Connection, critical (<10%): 3.5px dashed 8/4 + 'CRIT' chip.

tokens.name: edge-eol
tokens.usage: End of life: 6px dotted casing UNDER the mass line + clock glyph on the label.

tokens.name: edge-frig
tokens.usage: Frigate-only: 1.5px line with a diamond at midpoint + 'F' chip.

tokens.name: edge-unknown
tokens.usage: Unknown mass/type: 2px dashed 3/5 + '?' label.

tokens.name: edge-label-bg
tokens.usage: Plate behind WH type labels on edges (90% bg-1).

tokens.name: zk-none
tokens.usage: zKill no activity: 3 empty bar outlines.

tokens.usage: zKill low: 1 of 3 bars filled.

tokens.name: zk-med
tokens.usage: zKill medium: 2 of 3 bars filled.

tokens.name: zk-high
tokens.usage: zKill high: 3 of 3 bars filled.

tokens.name: zk-recent
tokens.usage: Recent kill <10 min: filled diamond with '!' in ink-inverse, beside the bars.

tokens.usage: Overlay window fill, 78% opaque. User-adjustable 55–92%.

tokens.usage: Overlay J-names, kill counts; also haloed.

styles.name: edge-label
styles.usage: WH type plate on a connection.

styles.usage: Overlay row base. Never below 11px; 600 weight so the halo doesn't eat strokes.

styles.name: overlay-mono
styles.usage: J-names and kill counts in overlay rows.
